title: Test procedures: environmental and durability (T-E1 to T-E7)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Durability tests (UV, wash/chlorine, salt spray, absorber indicator, tag survival, battery, EMC) are one-line entries. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write lab-ready procedures for T-E1–T-E7 with exposure conditions, cycle counts, post-exposure strength tests and pass criteria tied to REQ IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Every T-E test covered with REQ references
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
